13: // Based off of the FlatCombine system from Seagull-NR.
14: // A major difference is that one didn't make any use of storage, because storage was
15: // rather complicated to use, and it wasn't necessary.
16: // Now, I expect storage to be a lot easier to use, easier than the alternative.
17: 
18: verus! {
19: 
20: pub struct Request {
21:     pub rid: int,
22:     pub req: int,
23: }
24: 
25: pub struct Response {
26:     pub rid: int,
27:     pub resp: int,
28: }
29: 
30: #[is_variant]
31: pub enum Client {
32:     Idle,
33:     Waiting { rid: int },
34: }
35: 
36: #[is_variant]
37: pub enum Combiner {
38:     Collecting { elems: Seq<Option<int>> },
39:     Responding { elems: Seq<Option<int>>, idx: nat },
40: }
41: 
42: } // verus!
43: tokenized_state_machine! {
44:     FlatCombiner {
45:         fields {
46:             #[sharding(constant)]
47:             pub num_clients: nat,
48: 
49:             #[sharding(imap)]
50:             pub clients: IMap<nat, Client>,
51: 
52:             #[sharding(imap)]
53:             pub slots: IMap<nat, bool>,
54: 
55:             #[sharding(variable)]
56:             pub combiner: Combiner,
57: 
58:             #[sharding(storage_imap)]
59:             pub requests: IMap<nat, Request>,
60: 
61:             #[sharding(storage_imap)]
62:             pub responses: IMap<nat, Response>,
63:         }
64: 
65:         pub open spec fn valid_idx(self, i: nat) -> bool {
66:             0 <= i && i < self.num_clients
67:         }
68: 
69:         #[invariant]
70:         pub fn clients_complete(self) -> bool {
71:             forall |i: nat| (0 <= i && i < self.num_clients) ==
72:                 self.clients.dom().contains(i)
73:         }
74: 
75:         #[invariant]
76:         pub fn slots_complete(self) -> bool {
77:             forall |i: nat| (0 <= i && i < self.num_clients) ==
78:                 self.slots.dom().contains(i)
79:         }
80: 
81:         #[invariant]
82:         pub fn clients_size(self) -> bool {
83:             match self.combiner {
84:                 Combiner::Collecting{elems} => elems.len() <= self.num_clients,
85:                 Combiner::Responding{elems, idx} => elems.len() == self.num_clients &&
86:                     0 <= idx && idx <= self.num_clients,
87:             }
88:         }
89: 
90:         /*
91:         #[verifier::spec]
92:         fn should_have_req_stored(self, i: nat) -> bool {
93:             0 <= i
94:             && i < self.slots
95:             && self.slots.index(i)
96:             && match self.combiner {
97:                 Combiner::Collecting{elems} => elems.len() < i || elems.index(i).is_None()
98:                 Combiner::Responding{elems, idx} => idx >= i || elems.index(i).is_None()
99:             }
100:         }
101:         */
102: 
103:         pub open spec fn client_waiting(self, i: nat) -> bool {
104:             self.valid_idx(i)
105:             && self.clients.index(i).is_Waiting()
106:         }
107: 
108:         pub open spec fn combiner_has(self, i: nat) -> bool {
109:             self.valid_idx(i)
110:             && match self.combiner {
111:                 Combiner::Collecting{elems} => i < elems.len() && elems.index(i as int).is_Some(),
112:                 Combiner::Responding{elems, idx} => i >= idx && elems.index(i as int).is_Some(),
113:             }
114:         }
115: 
116:         pub open spec fn combiner_rid(self, i: nat) -> int {
117:             match self.combiner {
118:                 Combiner::Collecting{elems} => elems.index(i as int).get_Some_0(),
119:                 Combiner::Responding{elems, idx} => elems.index(i as int).get_Some_0(),
120:             }
121:         }
122: 
123:         pub open spec fn request_stored(self, i: nat) -> bool {
124:             self.requests.dom().contains(i)
125:         }
126: 
127:         pub open spec fn response_stored(self, i: nat) -> bool {
128:             self.responses.dom().contains(i)
129:         }
130: 
131:         #[invariant]
132:         pub fn not_waiting_inv(self) -> bool {
133:             forall |i: nat| #[trigger] self.valid_idx(i) && self.clients.index(i).is_Idle() ==>

135:         }
136: 
137:         #[invariant]
138:         pub fn waiting_inv(self) -> bool {

143:         #[invariant]
144:         pub fn request_stored_inv(self) -> bool {

149:         }
150: 
151:         #[invariant]
152:         pub fn response_stored_inv(self) -> bool {
153:             forall |i: nat| #[trigger] self.response_stored(i) ==>
154:                 self.client_waiting(i)
155:                 && self.responses.index(i).rid == self.clients.index(i).get_Waiting_rid()
156:                 && !self.slots.index(i)
157:         }
158: 
159: 
160:         #[invariant]
161:         pub fn combiner_has_inv(self) -> bool {
162:             forall |i: nat| #[trigger] self.combiner_has(i) ==>
163:                 self.client_waiting(i)
164:                 && self.slots.index(i)
165:                 && self.combiner_rid(i) == self.clients.index(i).get_Waiting_rid()
166:                 && !self.request_stored(i)
167:         }

169:         init!{
170:             initialize(num_clients: nat) {
171:                 init num_clients = num_clients;
172:                 init clients = IMap::new(

174:                     |i: nat| Client::Idle);
175:                 init slots = IMap::new(

177:                     |i: nat| false);
178:                 init combiner = Combiner::Collecting { elems: Seq::empty() };

180:                 init responses = IMap::empty();
181:             }
182:         }
183: 
184:         #[inductive(initialize)]
185:         fn init_inductive(post: Self, num_clients: nat) { }
186: 
187:         ///// Client transitions
188: 
189:         transition!{
190:             client_send(j: nat, request: Request, cur_slot: bool) {
191:                 require(0 <= j && j < pre.num_clients);
192: 
193:                 // Move client to 'waiting' state
194:                 remove clients -= [j => Client::Idle];
195:                 add    clients += [j => Client::Waiting{rid: request.rid}];
196: 
197:                 // Set the slot
198:                 remove slots -= [j => cur_slot];
199:                 add    slots += [j => true];
200: 
201:                 // deposit the request
202:                 deposit requests += [j => request] by {
203:                     assert(!pre.request_stored(j));
204:                 };
205:             }
206:         }
207: 
208:         #[inductive(client_send)]
209:         fn client_send_inductive(pre: Self,
210:             post: Self, j: nat, request: Request, cur_slot: bool)
211:         {
212:         }
213: 
214:         transition!{
215:             client_recv(j: nat) {
216:                 require(0 <= j && j < pre.num_clients);
217: 
218:                 // Move client to 'idle' state
219:                 remove clients -= [j => let Client::Waiting{rid}];
220:                 add    clients += [j => Client::Idle];
221: 
222:                 // Check that the slot has been set back to 'false'
223:                 have slots >= [j => false];
224: 
225:                 // withdraw the response
226:                 withdraw responses -= [j => let response] by {
227:                     assert(pre.client_waiting(j));
228:                     //assert(!pre.request_stored(j));
229:                     //assert(!pre.combiner_has(j));
230:                     //assert(pre.response_stored(j));
231:                 };
232: 
233:                 // make sure we get back the response for the correct request id:
234:                 assert(response.rid == rid) by {
235:                     assert(pre.client_waiting(j));
236:                 };
237:             }
238:         }
239: 
240:         #[inductive(client_recv)]
241:         fn client_recv_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, j: nat) {
242:         }
243: 
244:         ///// Combiner transitions
245: 
246:         transition!{
247:             combiner_recv() {
248:                 require(pre.combiner.is_Collecting());
249:                 let j = pre.combiner.get_Collecting_elems().len();
250:                 require(0 <= j && j < pre.num_clients);
251: 
252:                 // Observe that the slot has been set to 'true'
253:                 have slots >= [j => true];
254: 
255:                 // Withdraw a request
256:                 withdraw requests -= [j => let request] by {
257:                     assert(pre.valid_idx(j));
258:                     assert(pre.client_waiting(j));
259:                     assert(pre.request_stored(j));
260:                 };
261: 
262:                 // Update combiner's local state to remember we withdrew a request with this ID
263:                 update combiner = Combiner::Collecting{

265:                 };
266:             }
267:         }
268: 
269:         #[inductive(combiner_recv)]
270:         fn combiner_recv_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
271:         }

274:             combiner_skip() {
275:                 require(pre.combiner.is_Collecting());
276:                 let j = pre.combiner.get_Collecting_elems().len();
277:                 require(0 <= j && j < pre.num_clients);
278: 
279:                 // In practice, this happens when slot j is set to false, so we could add this:
280:                 //    have slots >= [j => false];
281:                 // but it's not necessary
282: 
283:                 // Update combiner's local state to remember that we didn't withdraw
284:                 // anything here.
285:                 update combiner = Combiner::Collecting{
286:                     elems: pre.combiner.get_Collecting_elems().push(Option::None),
287:                 };
288:             }
289:         }
290: 
291:         #[inductive(combiner_skip)]
292:         fn combiner_skip_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
293:         }
294: 
295:         transition!{

297:                 require(pre.combiner.is_Collecting());
298:                 require(pre.combiner.get_Collecting_elems().len() == pre.num_clients);

318:                 add    slots += [j => false];

324:                 };

353:             }
